brief: Given our goal of reaching £20k MRR within 12 months while keeping monthly churn under 4%, should we increase the Pro plan price from £49 to £59 per month with the next Pro feature release?
assistant_text:
I’ve built a comparison model with three routes: **keep £49 with the release**, **raise to £59 with the release**, and **phase the increase after the release**.

Known from your brief: current Pro price is **£49/month**; the target is **£20k MRR**; and monthly churn must stay below **4%**. The 12‑month deadline is retained in the decision record, but the model’s goal projection cannot encode a deadline—so it currently treats this as reaching £20k rather than explicitly reaching it within a year.

It cannot yet say whether to raise price: current Pro subscribers, conversion, churn, and the release’s value are unknown. I have prepared one set of **starting assumptions—not measurements**—so you can test the trade-off:

- **Monthly churn: 3%** — a working baseline below the 4% ceiling.
- **Pro conversion rate: 5%** — provisional baseline pending funnel data.
- **Pro feature value: 70 out of 100** — assumes a meaningfully valuable release.
- **Pro subscriber count: 250 subscribers** — provisional current base.

And the options would be set as follows:

- **Keep £49 With Release:** feature value **70 out of 100**.
- **Raise to £59 With Release:** feature value **70 out of 100**; price already represented as **£59/month**.
- **Phase Price After Release:** feature value **70 out of 100**; eventual price **£59/month**.

The phased option’s timing and any interim price are not represented, so it is a weaker comparison until those are specified.

If you approve these assumptions, I’ll save them as one change and run the comparison.

The model was saved. Questions this model does not answer yet: What are the current Pro conversion rate, Pro subscriber count, and monthly churn rate? How much customer value will the next Pro feature release add, and will it be available at the same time as the price change? How price-sensitive are prospective and existing Pro customers at £59 per month?
